name: matchi
description: Read-only access to a real-estate broker's Matchi CRM: leads, properties, smart matches, calls, calendar, deals and market prices.

interface.longDescription:
Matchi is a CRM and AI assistant for real-estate brokers in Israel. This app lets a broker ask ChatGPT about their own Matchi business data - clients, properties, calls, schedule and deals - in Hebrew or English.

What ChatGPT can read:
- CRM leads (buyers, sellers, recruits) with their timeline, tasks and documents
- The broker's properties and their statistics
- Smart matches between buyers and properties
- Calls to the broker's Matchi number, with AI summaries
- Calendar, viewings and open tasks
- Facebook-group leads
- Deals, agreements, offers and office colleagues
- Portrait, logo and marketing media
- The broker's WhatsApp chat history with Matchi
- Market listings and asking prices

Example questions: "Which of my leads haven't I followed up with this week?", "Find buyers for my 4-room apartment on Herzl Street", "What's on my calendar tomorrow?", "Summarize my open deals."

The app is read-only: it cannot change, send or delete anything. Each broker signs in with their Matchi account and approves the connection, and sees only what their own account can see. Brokers can disconnect at any time from Personal details > AI apps in Matchi.

Requires a Matchi broker account (app.matchi.co.il).
capabilities: Read CRM leads, tasks and timelines
defaultPrompt: What do I need to do today in Matchi?
Which of my buyers are looking to buy in Petah Tikva, and what are their budgets?
What are 4-room apartments in Tel Aviv asking right now?

positive.description: Daily worklist: overdue, today's and upcoming follow-up tasks from the CRM.
positive.prompt: What do I need to do today in Matchi?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the broker's open CRM follow-up tasks bucketed by due date (overdue / today / upcoming), each with its lead - e.g. call Noa Cohen (נועה כהן), viewing with Michal Mizrahi (מיכל מזרחי) in Petah Tikva, exclusivity meeting with Tamar Friedman (תמר פרידמן) - plus new leads nobody has touched yet. Read-only; nothing is changed.

positive.description: Find buyers in the CRM by city and show their budgets.
positive.prompt: Which of my buyers are looking to buy in Petah Tikva, and what are their budgets?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the buyer leads looking to buy in Petah Tikva (פתח תקווה) with their budgets, e.g. Michal Mizrahi (מיכל מזרחי) up to 3,600,000 ILS and Itai Peretz (איתי פרץ) and Daniel Azulai (דניאל אזולאי) up to 4,200,000 ILS. Data is in Hebrew.

positive.description: Open one lead's full CRM card.
positive.prompt: Show me the full card of Tamar Friedman, my seller in Ramat Gan.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the seller lead Tamar Friedman (תמר פרידמן) and shows her full card: Ramat Gan, 3-room apartment, asking 4,200,000 ILS, remarks about an inherited apartment and exclusivity, and her open exclusivity-meeting task.

positive.description: Open-market asking prices for a city and room count (Diamond plan).
positive.prompt: What are 4-room apartments for sale in Tel Aviv asking right now? Give me the median and the price per sqm.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns statistics over active Yad2 / Madlan / Facebook ads from the last 90 days for 4-room apartments for sale in Tel Aviv: median, 25th-75th percentile and range of asking prices and price per sqm. States that these are asking prices, not closed deals.

positive.description: The broker's own plan and usage.
positive.prompt: What Matchi plan am I on, and how much of it have I used this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the account is on the Diamond plan (solo broker) and lists per-feature usage against the plan limits with reset dates.

negative.description: General knowledge request unrelated to the broker's Matchi data.
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about the sea.

negative.description: Weather question; Matchi has no weather data.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Tel Aviv tomorrow?

negative.description: Write request; the app is read-only and has no tool that deletes or changes CRM data.
negative.prompt: Delete the lead Yoav Levi from my Matchi CRM.

review.commerce_description: Matchi does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT; the app only reads the broker's own data.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to a broker's own Matchi data (CRM leads, properties, smart matches, calls, calendar, deals, media, Matchi chat history and open-market prices) through OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration.
